title: One feature across two repositories (Java library and service)
summary: One requirement changes a shared Java library and the service that depends on it: BOSS plans one change set, builds the library lane, then the service lane against the library's unmerged branch, runs the cross-repo check, takes one approval and merges in order.

pending.waits_for: BOSSAPP-1363 (sample repos bank-common + bank-payments-service; the service lane built against the library branch)
pending.why: the multi-repo change set has never run end to end on an install: no sample repos and no proof that the service sandbox builds against the library's unmerged branch

fixtures: a multi-repo app (app_key) whose components are a Java library and a service depending on it

defaults.title: Add a currency field to the shared payment DTO
defaults.instructions: Add `currency` (ISO 4217) to PaymentDto in the library, and have the service set and return it.
criteria: the service's payment response includes currency

acceptance.text: BOSS planned one change set across both repositories
